id: title:Gilbert09:treat eai again redis dns failures as transient

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Redis transient error handling to the activity execution path, potentially allowing recovery from transient Redis DNS failures rather than reporting them as permanent errors.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F1.H4 and P1.F1.H3 show the execution path and integration of Redis error handling, including checks for transient Redis errors. This could help PostHog recover from transient Redis DNS failures. However, the chunk P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H2 are missing the actual Redis error handling implementation, and the chunk P1.F2.H1 and P1.F3.H1 provide the Redis error implementation
review.uncertainty: The chunk P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H2 are missing the actual Redis error handling implementation, and the chunk P1.F2.H1 and P1.F3.H1 provide the Redis error implementation and tests, but P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H2 are missing the actual P1. This could lead to incomplete implementation and potential issues.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the Redis error handling.
